pages.text: In V = IR, V is I times R. To make I the [[subject]], the letter on its own, undo the × R by dividing both sides by R. So I = V ÷ R.

pages.name: Undo it
pages.task: V = IR. To make R the subject, what do you do to both sides?
pages.why: R is multiplied by I, and dividing undoes multiplying. Divide both sides by I, so R = V ÷ I.

pages.name: Undo a divide
pages.task: I = V ÷ R. Which formula gives V?
pages.why: V is divided by R, and multiplying undoes dividing. Multiply both sides by R, so V = I × R. As a check, 2 × 8 = 16.

pages.name: Change side, change sign

pages.name: Power
pages.task: P = VI. Which formula gives I?
pages.why: I is multiplied by V, so divide both sides by V. As a check, 2300 ÷ 230 = 10. The units agree too, since watts ÷ volts gives amps.

pages.name: Undo a sum
pages.task: v = u + at. Which formula gives t?
pages.why: The steps done to t are × a, then + u. Undo the + u first, then the × a, so t = (v − u) ÷ a. As a check, (18 − 6) ÷ 3 = 4.

pages.task: v = u + at. Which formula gives a?
